nonWaivableInvariants.text: Never clear or delete the last durable copy before the next ownership boundary acknowledges it.
Capture, transcription, enrichment, and retry paths perform no undisclosed network inference or content upload.
An ambiguous provider commit enters unknownOutcome unless a marker or verified receipt proves completion.
Untrusted inputs and FFI chunks are bounded and oversize input fails without clearing staged content.
Evidence and diagnostics contain no captured content, filenames, URIs, coordinates, transcripts, audio, or storage handles.
Wear source deletion requires durable correlated sourceDeletionAuthorized after vaultCommitted; storage pressure cannot silently weaken the threshold.

cases.title: Abrupt process kill preserves recorder prefix
cases.expected: After abrupt process kill and explicit relaunch, the durable prefix is recoverable with no more than two seconds lost.

cases.title: Force-stop and reboot recovery
cases.expected: Explicit relaunch offers finalize, recover, or discard for the last durable prefix; continuous recording is not claimed.

cases.title: Interruption, mic revoke, and zero-input handling
cases.expected: Call interruption, device mic toggle, permission revocation, and zero input become distinct actionable durable states without deleting audio.

cases.title: Create new note and attachments with verification
cases.expected: Attachments commit before note; each artifact and note is read back and length/hash verified.

cases.title: Revoked grant preserves queue
cases.expected: Revoked permission enters needsPermission and the staged package remains recoverable through re-selection.

cases.title: Offline, slow, and eventually consistent provider
cases.expected: The operation completes or reaches durable retry/unknownOutcome within the watchdog without blocking UI or duplicating content.

cases.title: Crash-window reconciliation
cases.expected: Injected crashes before, during, and immediately after commit reconcile using marker/hash/receipt or require explicit inspection.

cases.title: Large-screen lifecycle and responsive capture
cases.expected: Rotation, resize, split-screen, background, and foreground transitions preserve the durable recording and editable capture state while warm and cold latency gates pass.

cases.title: Large-screen provider picker and durable delivery
cases.expected: Expanded, split-screen, and resized provider flows preserve staged content and finish or enter a durable actionable state without duplicate delivery.

cases.title: Disconnected 72-hour and ten-recording retention
cases.expected: Ten synthetic recordings remain recoverable through 72 hours disconnected and reconcile when the phone returns.

cases.title: Duplicate, corrupt, and resumed transfer
cases.expected: Duplicate/corrupt chunks are rejected or deduplicated and transfer resumes from durable frontiers with checksum verification.

cases.title: Phone reinstall and acknowledgement reconciliation
cases.expected: Phone reinstall cannot cause silent watch deletion; outstanding IDs and acknowledgements reconcile explicitly.

cases.title: Storage-pressure retention frontier
cases.expected: Below the normal free-space floor, the watch offers explicit recovery/discard and never silently weakens acknowledgement-based deletion.

cases.title: Text/link durable enqueue latency
cases.expected: Saved locally is not shown before the package is durable and p95 meets the gate.

cases.title: Quick Capture warm/cold latency
cases.expected: Editable UI latency meets warm and cold gates.

cases.title: Rust materialization latency and memory
cases.expected: Streamed materialization meets latency, memory, chunk, and aggregate gates.

cases.title: SAF watchdog
cases.expected: Provider operation finishes or enters durable actionable state within the watchdog.

cases.title: Recorder durability and memory
cases.expected: A 60-minute recording has bounded prefix loss, no thermal warning, and no unbounded memory growth.

cases.title: Local ASR performance
cases.expected: Declared launch model meets RTF, memory, and cancellation gates without network inference.

cases.title: Wear endurance and transfer
cases.expected: Recording endurance, battery, integrity, and stable-connection transfer gates pass.

cases.title: M2 native core packaging budgets
cases.expected: Source-built core artifacts remain within absolute and growth budgets.
